patterns.message: The simulation is headless: it reads intents and writes moments; drawing, camera, effects and UI live in the host folders.
src/gpu is generic pixi code meant for upstreaming: import only pixi.js and its own files.
look builds the world and actors: read the simulation through ../sim/index.ts, share art through ../art, and leave effects to vfx and screens to ui.
src/gpu is the host's compile watch and warm-up: installs take its types from host/types.ts.
vfx draws transient effects from moments and view data: read the simulation through ../sim/index.ts, share art through ../art, and leave the world to look and screens to ui.
src/gpu is the host's compile watch and warm-up: installs take its types from host/types.ts.

title stages the title's 3D scene: build it from look's actors, vfx's drawing helpers, art and the camera, read the simulation through ../sim/index.ts, take only types from ../host/types.ts, and hear the menu through art/title-cues.ts.
src/gpu is the host's compile watch and warm-up: installs take its types from host/types.ts.

The lab drives the game through the debug API (host/debug.ts) and reads it through sim/index.ts; it borrows the UI's menu, panel and DOM helpers and look's ink material, and leaves drawing the game to look, vfx and render.
src/gpu is the host's compile watch and warm-up: installs take its types from host/types.ts.
ui draws screens and the HUD from view data and sends intents: read the simulation through ../sim/index.ts and leave 3D to look, render and vfx.
src/gpu is the host's compile watch and warm-up: installs take its types from host/types.ts.
